title: When Do Surrogate Metrics Work? A Finite-Sample Comparison Under Realistic Failure Modes
abstract: arXiv:2609.30528v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online experiments must often be evaluated before long-term outcomes mature. Under rolling enrollment, these outcomes are observed only for early enrollees, while short-term surrogates are available for everyone. We compare seven estimators across eleven data-generating processes, spanning partial mediation, drift, outcome sparsity, and enrollment-time labeling, with up to $R = 2,000$ replications over more than 500 method-by-scenario cells. We find a sharp robustness-efficiency tradeoff: the surrogate index delivers large efficiency gains when surrogacy holds but its coverage collapses under violations, while PPI-family methods stay asymptotically valid under random labeling at smaller gains. We give the finite-sample variance of PPI++ in the all-units parameterization for a fixed predictor, a joint asymptotic distribution for the two estimators under cross-fitting, and a Hausman-type estimator-disagreement diagnostic, then quantify t

translated_title: 代理指标何时有效？现实失效模式下的有限样本比较
translated_abstract: 在线实验往往需要在长期结果成熟之前进行评估。在滚动入组的情形下，长期结果只能对早期入组者进行观测，而短期代理指标则对所有人均可用。我们在十一种数据生成过程下比较了七种估计方法，涵盖部分中介、漂移、结果稀疏性和入组时间标注等情形，并在超过500个“方法×场景”组合单元中进行了多达 R = 2,000 次重复实验。我们发现存在显著的鲁棒性-效率权衡：当代理关系成立时，代理指数能带来巨大的效率提升，但在代理关系被违反时其覆盖率会崩溃；而 PPI 系列方法在随机标注下保持渐近有效性，但效率提升相对较小。我们给出了固定预测器下全体单元参数化的 PPI++ 有限样本方差、交叉拟合下两种估计量的联合渐近分布，以及一种 Hausman 型的估计量分歧诊断方法，并进一步量化……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过涵盖十一种数据生成过程的大规模模拟，揭示了代理指数与PPI系列方法之间尖锐的鲁棒性-效率权衡，并贡献了PPI++的有限样本方差、交叉拟合下的联合渐近分布以及Hausman型估计量分歧诊断等新理论工具。
en_tdlr: By comparing seven estimators across eleven data-generating processes, this paper reveals a sharp robustness-efficiency tradeoff between surrogate indices and PPI-family methods, and contributes the finite-sample variance of PPI++, a joint asymptotic distribution under cross-fitting, and a Hausman-type estimator-disagreement diagnostic.
